scientific_question: Do learned target prices tighten ENPDA's repaired assignment-dual certificate relative to analytic congestion prices and zero prices?

price_sources.learned: prices after four frozen ENPDA rounds
price_sources.analytic: prices after the identical four-round analytic congestion update, with all neural residuals disabled

isolation.lower_bound: the same seed-specific frozen ENPDA-Solver incumbent for all three price sources
isolation.repair: the same deterministic nonnegative scaling grid and row-potential repair
isolation.secondary_metric: fraction for which the integer upper bound closes the incumbent
